entities.summary: Cuthbert Tunstall was an English humanist, bishop, diplomat, administrator and royal adviser. He served as Bishop of Durham during the reigns of Henry VIII, Edward VI, Mary I and Elizabeth I. He has been described as having "invincible" or "burning moderation" on Erasmian Catholic lines.
